_comment: Levels, labels and customs [VERIFY] with a teacher of the country before the preset is advertised (PLAN.md 9.41). Γενικό Λύκειο (the general upper secondary school, three years after the Gymnasio, which is a separate school: gr-gymnasio). Sections (τμήματα) numbered Α1, Β2, Γ3 like the Gymnasio's; some schools write them Α΄1 or with letters, and the Β΄ and Γ΄ classes may be formed by track (Γ΄: Ανθρωπιστικές, Θετικές, Τεχνολογικές, Οικονομίας) [VERIFY]. The vocational ΕΠΑΛ and the evening Lykeio are not covered (change the levels and the label template). The Latin look-alikes A and B are accepted for Α and Β in register files [VERIFY]. The school year starts on 1 September, as in gr-gymnasio [VERIFY]. After the Γ΄ a pupil leaves (Πανελλαδικές exams).
